name: Mahila Udyam Nidhi (MUN) Scheme
description: SIDBI & NABARD scheme offering financial assistance and soft equity up to ₹10 Lakhs at 7.5% interest rate to women entrepreneurs for setting up new micro-enterprises in rural & semi-urban areas.
nodalAgency: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) / NABARD
targetAudience: Women entrepreneurs starting micro-enterprises in rural & semi-urban areas
requiredDocuments: Proof of Business Premise / Lease Deed
